title: GdUnit4
summary: Unit testing: test suites that extend GdUnitTestSuite, with fluent asserts, signal asserts, a scene runner, mocks and spies, run headless from the command line.
useWhen: The game has rules or systems worth checking automatically, including scenes driven frame by frame or with simulated input actions, and you want tests that run headless with godot_script after each change.
avoidWhen: A one-off check is enough: print the values in a game run or read them with godot_eval instead.
